# Polyflow — Spatial Engineering Studio

Polyflow is a spatial engineering studio in Bucharest, Romania, specializing in premium 3D website design, WebGL development, and immersive digital experiences.

## What We Do

Polyflow designs and builds high-performance 3D websites using Three.js, WebGL, custom GLSL shaders, and GSAP animation. Every project targets 60 FPS on mobile devices including iOS Safari. We call our projects Digital Landmarks — immersive web experiences that function as brand assets, not just websites.

## Services

- **3D Website Design**: Premium spatial websites built with Three.js and WebGL. Scroll-driven camera animation, custom shaders, post-processing.
- **WebGL Development**: Custom WebGL/Three.js development for agencies and brands. Performance-first architecture targeting 60 FPS on all devices.
- **Immersive Web Experiences**: Full-scope immersive digital experiences for luxury and premium brands. Spatial storytelling, interactive 3D, scroll-driven narrative.

## Technical Stack

- Three.js / WebGL / WebGPU
- Custom GLSL vertex and fragment shaders
- GSAP + ScrollTrigger for scroll-driven animation
- Lenis for smooth scrolling
- Vite for build tooling
- Vercel for deployment

## Key Differentiators

- 60 FPS guaranteed on mobile (iOS Safari) and desktop
- Custom shader development (not template-based)
- Scroll-driven 3D camera choreography as a core competency
- Computer science-first approach to web performance
- Bucharest-based with European and global client reach
